import pytest


def test_fibfib():
    # Base cases
    assert fibfib(0) == 0
    assert fibfib(1) == 0
    assert fibfib(2) == 1

    # Recursive cases
    assert fibfib(3) == 1   # 1 + 0 + 0
    assert fibfib(4) == 2   # 1 + 1 + 0
    assert fibfib(5) == 4   # 2 + 1 + 1
    assert fibfib(6) == 7   # 4 + 2 + 1
    assert fibfib(7) == 13  # 7 + 4 + 2
    assert fibfib(8) == 24  # 13 + 7 + 4
    assert fibfib(9) == 44  # 24 + 13 + 7

    # Larger value (verify recurrence consistency)
    assert fibfib(10) == fibfib(9) + fibfib(8) + fibfib(7)

    # Recurrence relation holds for a range of values
    values = [fibfib(i) for i in range(15)]
    for i in range(3, 15):
        assert values[i] == values[i - 1] + values[i - 2] + values[i - 3]

    # Type check
    assert isinstance(fibfib(5), int)
